name: Quantum Energy, Inc.
summary: Quantum Energy, Inc. primarily operates within the United States, specializing in the acquisition and refinement of rare earth elements, various metals, and oxides. The company then transforms these raw materials into saline compounds and other oxides. Founded in 2004, the enterprise initially traded under the name Boomers Cultural Development Inc. before officially rebranding to Quantum Energy, Inc. in May 2006. Its corporate headquarters are situated in North Las Vegas, Nevada.
